## Why This Is Asked
This question probes privacy-first thinking in real-time ML on SageMaker with PrivateLink, a common production constraint. It tests data minimization, logging discipline, and practical ops decisions.

- PII protection and data minimization
- SageMaker endpoint sizing and Application Auto Scaling

## Code Example
```javascript
// PII hashing utility (server-agnostic example)
const crypto = require('crypto');
function hashPII(val){
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(val, 'utf8').digest('hex');
}
```
